note: On-chain license catalog of the GL1F Crypto registry. Order is the on-chain license id: entry 1 is set by the registry constructor, the rest are added at deployment. openness: 0 reserved, 1 restricted, 2 share-alike, 3 permissive, 4 public domain; a model's admin may move its model only to a later version of its license or to a higher openness. Summaries are informal; the linked license text governs. Not legal advice.
